name: Omoiro
source:
It's an elementary school where students aim to become painters. In such a school Hika fatefully meets Atsushi in the health room.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在一所小学里，学生们怀揣着成为画家的梦想。在这里，Hika与笃在保健室迎来了命中注定的相遇。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
